title: Jamaican Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with chicken, Jamaican seasonings, and low-carb vegetables. A perfect gluten-free meal for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: low-carb vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the piquant seasoning and Jamaican allspice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the low-carb vegetables to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the stew and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Jamaican chicken stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
